request.spec:
Work out for me whether an invoice is paid, part paid or still owing. Base it on the payments
I have recorded. I do not want to flip it to paid by hand anymore.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Work out for me whether an invoice is paid, part paid or still owing. Base it on the payments
I have recorded. I do not want to flip it to paid by hand anymore.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is complete and the acceptance test passes. Here's a summary of what I implemented.

## What changed

An invoice's status is now **worked out from the payments recorded against it** — SENT while unpaid, **PARTIAL** once part paid, **PAID** once the payments cover the amount — replacing the old "mark paid by hand" flip. No schema change was needed (the `payments` table from V19 and the derived `amount` already exist), so this is a pure server + front-end derivation.

### Server (OfficeFloor REST on Spring)
- **`InvoiceStatus.java`** (new) — one place for the rule: `derive(baseStatus, amount, paid)`. A DRAFT keeps its stored status; a SENT invoice becomes SENT / PARTIAL / PAID based on the summed payments.
- **`InvoicesGetLogic`** — the per-project list now sums each invoice's payments and returns a view with the derived status (DTO, so no accidental entity write).
- **`InvoiceDueGetLogic`** — the `/api/invoices/due` view now also carries the derived `status`, so the detail page reads the same rule.
- **`AllInvoicesGetLogic`** — the all-invoices page derives status too, for consistency.
- **`PaymentsPostLogic`** — recording a payment now appends the audit record `PAYMENT_RECORDED id=<invoiceId> amount=<n.nn>` through the `Audit` service.

### Front-end (additive — new files + minimal edits)
- **`features/invoices/status.slot.tsx`** (new) — a panel filling the `invoice.detail` region that shows `data-testid="invoice-status"`, reading the server-derived status via the shared `['invoices', 'due', id]` query key (so it refreshes on its own when a payment is recorded).
- **`invoiceDue.ts`** — added `status` to the `InvoiceDue` type.
- **`InvoiceList.tsx` / `invoices.ts`** — removed the hand-operated "Mark paid" button and its now-dead `usePayInvoice` mutation, honoring "I do not want to flip it to paid by hand anymore." The row's existing `invoice-status` cell now shows the derived status.

Frontend `npm run typecheck` passes and `bin/e2e` reports **1 passed**.

One note: I left the now-unused server `POST /api/invoices/pay` endpoint (`InvoicesPayLogic` + its YAML) in place since removing a wired route is a wider change than this request needs — it's simply no longer reachable from the UI. Say the word if you'd like it removed too.
